title: Trust grants: what the user has admitted, as pure data
description: The durable half of the trust model (a trust record = content fingerprint + the surface granted at the time). Lives in the user directory (default ~/.lattice/trust.json) because a grant is a user-level, cross-session fact — one ledger is one conversation, but 'I trusted this' is not per-conversation. The trust gate consults this file; the granting itself is also recorded as a decision event on the ledger of the conversation where it happened.

key.description: The canonical fingerprint of the admitting call's arguments (sha256 of key-sorted JSON, reason excluded) — content-addressed: the same source string or the same inline code, nothing else

admits.description: What kind of thing the granted call introduces (components, skills, ...) — from the tool's declared surface

effects.description: The full effect surface the tool declared WHEN GRANTED. A later call whose declaration differs does not match — changed appetite means re-confirmation.

summary.description: Human-readable note of what was granted (a source URL, a tool name)

granted_by.description: The ledger event id of the authorization answer (or 'manual' for a hand-added grant)
